featured_reviews.name: Known
featured_reviews.review_text:
Don’t fall for fake, forced reviews. Let me tell you the truth.

There are almost no real placements in this college  barely anything. Our families, and the families of other students, came here with hope that we would get placed. But the reality is completely different.

This college is greedy. They keep forcing students to do unnecessary things just to improve their image in the university rankings and among other colleges. But what are they actually giving to the students?
Nothing special.

The education quality is average, but the fees increase every single year like a rocket. Since the day I joined, I haven’t seen any real improvement in facilities, training, or placements  only the fees have increased.

One day, when you join you will realize that you made a mistake.

Another important thing:
They force students to take NPTEL courses, pay ₹1000, and give exams. Why? Because the university itself no longer has enough value to make students feel confident about their future.

Be honest
I have never seen a company that says:
"If you don’t have an NPTEL certificate you won’t get a job."
Yes it might matter for a few companies, but no one has the right to force students to do it

The same goes for publishing research papers.
Not publishing a paper does NOT mean you won’t get a job.

This whole system is messed up.
Instead of actually training students for industry and proper placements they keep following old useless practices.

Right now I am preparing everything by myself  from A to Z.
The college is just for the degree.

I m not a student who bunk classes.
I m regular.
I score 75–80+.
I m serious about my future.

I m not writing this for fun
I m writing this because I m frustrated.

Our education system needs fixing.
Students deserve real training, real opportunities and real placements  not just fake promises.
